name: LightBar
author: rezaadev

sections.description:
LightBar is a simple and professional notification bar plugin for WordPress.
Perfect for displaying announcements, promotions, or important alerts.

✨ Features:
* Manage notification text and colors from WordPress Customizer
* Customizable background color
* Customizable text color
* Customizable button background color
* Customizable button text color
* Customizable button link
* Customizable close button
* Fixed at the top of the page
* Responsive and lightweight
* Translation ready (default English, supports .po/.mo files)

Arbitrary section

This plugin is open-source and free to use. Contributions are welcome on GitHub:
https://github.com/rezaadev
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/lightbar/ directory, or install directly through the WordPress plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to Appearance > Customize > LightBar Settings to configure your notification bar.
sections.faq:
Can I change the background and text colors?

Yes, you can set both background and text colors directly in the WordPress Customizer.

Will this slow down my website?

No, the plugin is lightweight and optimized for performance.

Does it work with all themes?

Yes, it should work with any theme that follows WordPress coding standards.

Is it translation ready?

Yes, it includes a .pot file and supports .po and .mo translations. Default language is English.
